title: Directory Owners Output
description: Schema for the aggregated directory_owners.json output file.

directories.description: Maps forward-slash repository-relative directory paths ("" for the checkout root) to their Google Issue Tracker component_id and proximity-ranked list of owners.

component_id.description: The Google Issue Tracker component ID resolved from the nearest METADATA.textproto file in this directory or an ancestor.

owners.description: Proximity-ordered list of structured owners for this directory.

email.description: Owner email address declared in owners_file.

tier.description: 1-based sequential ownership tier ranked by proximity, advancing without gaps for each (owners_step, include_depth) level that contributes at least one novel owner.

owners_step.description: 1-based index of the non-root ancestor OWNERS file that contributed at least one novel owner when walking up from the directory.

include_depth.description: Breadth-first include or file: hop count from the ancestor OWNERS file at owners_step (0 for direct owners, 1+ for included files).

dir_distance.description: Number of directory hops up from the directory to the ancestor OWNERS file at owners_step (0 for the directory itself).

owners_file.description: Forward-slash repository-relative path to the OWNERS file where email was declared.
